answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. Before an identity may answer, it proves sequential work tied to this epoch's seed — a puzzle no shortcut solves faster. One honest key does it once; 140 fakes must do it 140 times, so the farm's electricity bill grows faster than its emission. A rented botnet still pays the same seconds per key, so the farm's bill scales linearly. The meadow test is the live device, the cipher test is the locked stake, and the cedar test is the graded history no template can fake. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
